recognize_zh: 這顆淋巴樣細胞比小淋巴球稍大，核圓至橢圓、染色質中度濃縮，中央隱約可見一個小核仁，細胞質深嗜鹼性且左緣有小突起（cytoplasmic bleb），這些是 T 前淋巴球白血病（T-PLL）細胞的線索，但需免疫表型確認。
features: Single medium-sized lymphoid cell, larger than a small mature lymphocyte
Moderate N:C ratio with round to slightly oval, eccentric nucleus
Moderately condensed, somewhat clumped chromatin with a faint small central nucleolus
Moderate amount of deeply basophilic cytoplasm without granules
Small cytoplasmic protrusion (bleb) at the left cell border
Background normocytic red cells without other leukocytes in field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized atypical lymphoid cell among unremarkable red cells. The cell has a round to oval nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin and a small, inconspicuous nucleolus, surrounded by a moderate rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with a small cytoplasmic bleb. A single cell cannot establish the diagnosis, but in context the morphology is consistent with T-prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation requires flow cytometry (CD3+, CD7 bright) and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement studies.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: B-lineage prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus and paler cytoplasm without blebs, and flow cytometry shows B-cell markers rather than CD3/CD7.
Sezary cells have cerebriform, deeply grooved nuclei with scant cytoplasm and are CD7 negative/CD26 negative, whereas T-PLL cells have rounder nuclei and basophilic blebbed cytoplasm.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous, with abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and basophilia at the periphery, rather than a monotonous population with blebs.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine hair-like projections, pale gray-blue cytoplasm and an oval or bean-shaped nucleus with no nucleolus, and are CD11c/CD25/CD103 positive B cells.
